1479-5233-8337.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, M'Ress, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and M'Ress trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

401-2530-3944-7286.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-7286.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

1765-4247-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1765-4247-5972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

147-3899-7166.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3899-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-2999-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2999-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

23-454-1651-7839.description:
Cause Orcish Vandal to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Orcish Vandal by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Orcish Vandal.
Repeat from step 2.

2816-7821-7891.description:
Activate Thranduil using Woodland Weavemaster's ability by tapping it, adding an amount of mana equal to Thranduil's power that can only be spent to cast Elf spells or activate abilities of Elves.
Activate Thranduil using the ability granted to it by Umbral Mantle by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2757-4385-6753.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two creature tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic land
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

1003-1778-5861-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-1778-5861-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

215-647-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3946-5447-7705.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

4050-4419--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2228-4762-7325.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Devoted Druid.
Resolve the Devoted Druid ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

864-3617-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Eternal Witness and exiling Ephemerate.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-5686-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5686-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5686-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

2113-2266-3430.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by tapping it, adding three snow mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by paying {1}{S}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4677-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1274-4186-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
1274-4186-6458.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1349-2438-4153.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has a coin counter on it.
1349-2438-4153.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Athreos trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter on another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature that died in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1339-3967-4063-6625.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3967-4775-6553.easyPrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
3967-4775-6553.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

1308-3951-5658.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to create two token copies of Éomer and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Put both Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Éomer tokens trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3944-5258-5618-5687.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Skittering Precursor and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile Blood Pet from the top of your library with the ability to play it until your next end step.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Blood Pet from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: can be on the battlefield transformed

1461-1939-4050-4078.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 if Lunarch Veteran is on the battlefield.
1461-1939-4050-4078.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it and Luminous Phantom trigger if its on the battlefield.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, if applicable, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Wurmcoil Engine trigger, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers twice if its on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
When the Wurms die, Luminous Phantom triggers twice if it is on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if its on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

549-1278-1651-4508.notablePrerequisites:
Lightning-Rig Crew does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two opponents.
549-1278-1651-4508.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Lightning-Rig Crew.
Repeat until you have one or less opponent remaining.

859-1884-4613.notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
859-1884-4613.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Silent Attendant's ability by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

914-1618-2806.notablePrerequisites: Reality Strobe in hand or exiled with at least one time counter on it.Opponents control at least nine artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1618-2806.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least nine Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate nine Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{U}{U}{R}.
If Reality Strobe is in your hand, cast it by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Otherwise, activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, causing you to time travel three times, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe and cast Reality Strobe from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Reality Strobe, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield, and exiling Reality Strobe with three time counters on it.
Repeat.
If opponents control ten or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and mana, and you may bounce other permanents using Reality Strobe.

313-325-1742-2438.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six cards in hand.
313-325-1742-2438.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Toluz triggers, exiling the discarded card.
Repeat from step 1 until you have an empty hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Toluz.
Toluz dies, returning all cards exiled with it to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Toluz from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Toluz enters the battlefield, causing it to connive.
Repeat.

224-765-872.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

391-1584-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-1584-4222.description:
Activate Teferi's Isle by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Teferi's Isle.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.
